theater: 瑞士中部琉森州與瓦萊州

battle.name: 分離同盟戰爭
battle.theater: 瑞士中部琉森州與瓦萊州
battle.brief: 一八四七年十一月下旬，聯邦議會的軍隊越過琉森州邊界，二十六天之內便把「分離同盟」七個天主教州壓垮，琉森城隨即陷落。卡面雷管步槍在聯邦軍的德語各州部隊中已是主力兵器，分離同盟一方的士兵多數仍用舊式燧發步槍與獵槍，火槍與火砲的數量差距先於教條分歧決定了戰局。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰的兩方是瑞士聯邦議會的軍隊與「分離同盟」。聯邦一方並無常備軍，軍隊由各州按人口與名額抽調的國民兵組成：蘇黎世、伯爾尼、瓦萊圖根、圖爾高、聖加侖、沙夫豪森與巴塞爾等德語各州出動主力，伯爾尼的兵力最多，蘇黎世與巴塞爾的裝備最齊，另有數州拒絕派兵或只出象徵性人數。聯邦軍由議會設置的指揮部統一調度，總指揮為將軍迪福爾，參謀與炮兵由他直接掌握；關鍵的技術單位是德語各州的炮兵連與工兵連，以及以獵兵為骨幹的狙擊排。宗教上支持聯邦的多數是德語與法語的新教各州以及部分天主教州，蘇黎世、伯爾尼與阿爾高是骨幹。分離同盟則由七個天主教州組成，即琉森、烏里、施維茨、瓦爾登、楚格、弗萊堡與瓦萊州；它有自己的聯邦條款、議會、印璽、鑄幣與徵召制度，並在琉森設有總部。分離同盟的軍隊以各州守備隊與短期徵召的民兵組成，軍官多為天主教舊軍人，士兵裝備落後而忠誠度高，人數並不少，訓練與火力卻不足；它得到奧地利與若干歐洲天主教君主在道義上的支持，卻沒有得到任何一國的實際出兵。
countriesEn: The two sides were the army of the Swiss Federal Diet and the Sonderbund. The federal side had no standing army; its forces were drawn from the cantons' contingents, raised in proportion to population and quota: Zurich, Bern, Aargau, Thurgau, St. Gallen, Schaffhausen and Basel supplied the bulk of the men, Bern the largest contingent, Zurich and Basel the best equipped, while several cantons refused to send troops or sent token numbers only. The federal army was directed by a command set up by the Diet, with General Dufour in overall command and the staff and the artillery under his own hand; the crucial technical units were the artillery and engineer companies of the German-speaking cantons and the sharpshooter detachments built on their gamekeepers. In religious terms the federal side was supported by the German- and French-speaking Protestant cantons and by some Catholic ones, with Zurich, Bern and Aargau as its core. The Sonderbund was made up of seven Catholic cantons: Lucerne, Uri, Schwyz, Unterwalden, Zug, Fribourg and Valais. It had its own federal articles, its own assembly, its own seals, its own coinage and its own system of levies, with its headquarters at Lucerne. Its army was formed from the cantonal garrisons and short-term levies, commanded mostly by Catholic old officers, with poorly equipped but highly loyal soldiers; its numbers were not small, but its training and firepower were. It had the moral support of Austria and of several European Catholic sovereigns, and the actual intervention of none.
people: 聯邦軍的總指揮是將軍吉爾姆·亨利·迪福爾。他出身日內瓦，在革命與拿破崙時代以炮兵軍官身份歷戰，一八四七年受命統率聯邦軍；這場戰爭之後，他於一八六四年主持了日內瓦公約會議，惜墨守成規的歐洲在實踐上又拖延了半個世紀。聯邦軍的實際戰鬥由赫羅茲將軍與雷丁上校分掌中央與右翼：雷丁的右翼在聖米迦勒教堂與「三邦石碑」一線被分離同盟預備隊擊退，陣線幾乎被打斷，靠中央縱隊的突破與聯邦預備隊及時壓上才扭轉戰局。分離同盟一方的將領包括在琉森方面指揮的約瑟夫·馮·巴赫曼與其兄約翰·烏爾里希·馮·巴赫曼、在弗萊堡與瓦萊一線的布洛斯將軍，以及在恩特萊布赫山區依託地勢抵抗的溫瑟。政治上，與分離同盟對立的新教激進派領袖約拿斯·富勒與烏爾里希·奧赫森拜因主導了議會的決議與戰後的建國工作；分離同盟一方的政治領袖阿洛伊斯·馮·巴爾塔薩主持分離同盟議會，戰敗後流亡國外。教會方面，天主教會的修道院體系在戰後遭到清算，教宗與歐洲天主教勢力曾經試圖干預而未成。
peopleEn: The overall commander of the federal army was General Guillaume-Henri Dufour. Born in Geneva, he had served as an artillery officer through the revolutionary and Napoleonic wars, and in 1847 was given command of the federal forces; after this war he presided over the Geneva Convention conference of 1864, although conservative Europe would take another half century to put it into practice. The actual fighting was led by General Herzog in the centre and Colonel von Reding on the right: Reding's right wing was thrown back at the church of St. Michael and at the Dreibündenstein by the Sonderbund reserves, and only the breakthrough of the federal centre with the timely intervention of the federal reserves turned the battle. The Sonderbund commanders included Josef von Bachmann and his brother Johann Ulrich von Bachmann, who directed the fighting in the Lucerne area, General von Blois in Fribourg and Valais, and von Wiser, who held the Entlebuch highlands on ground of his own choosing. On the political side the Protestant radical leaders Jonas Furrer and Ulrich Ochsenbein drove the Diet's decisions and the work of state-building after the victory; the Sonderbund's political leader Alois von Balthasar presided over its assembly and went into exile after the defeat. On the church side, the system of Catholic monasteries was liquidated after the war, and attempts by the papacy and the Catholic powers of Europe to intervene came to nothing.
kits: 卡面這件雷管步槍在這場戰爭裡是「數量差距」的具體載體。瑞士各州軍械庫在一八四〇年代已備有法製一八四〇年型雷管步槍，經阿爾薩斯與萊茵河沿線的軍火商流入，部分德語各州另有奧地利一八四〇年代前期裝的韋恩德爾式雷管步槍；但聯邦軍各步兵營的標準槍械仍混有十八世紀末的燧發滑膛槍，獵兵排則以獵槍與輕型步槍為主，瞄準好而射速低。分離同盟的武裝更舊：農莊民兵手上的多是自家保存的燧發步槍與獵槍，零件自製、保養全靠本地工匠，冬季山地補給極難。炮兵是最殘酷的一環：聯邦軍出動的炮兵約有八十八門，包括六磅與十二磅野戰炮及臼砲，在射程與射速上全面壓過對方；分離同盟全境只有十餘門可用火炮，其中多數是鑄鐵老炮，彈藥產量與運輸同樣受限。騎兵方面，瑞士各州只有輕騎兵與傳令偵察兵，沒有獨立的騎兵旅；工兵攜帶築城器材與爆破用藥，用於拆毀橋樑、修道院壁壘與村莊圍牆。運輸依靠車隊與內河船，聯邦軍的糧秣自各州兵站分撥，分離同盟則靠修道院倉庫供應，這一差距在雪季被進一步放大。
kitsEn: The percussion rifle on this card was the concrete carrier of the numerical difference in this war. The Swiss cantonal arsenals already held French pattern 1840 percussion muskets in the 1840s, coming in through the arms dealers of Alsace and the Rhine, and several German-speaking cantons also had the Austrian Werndl percussion rifles of the early 1840s. Even so, the standard weapon of the federal line companies was still a mixture that included late eighteenth-century flintlock smoothbores, while the gamekeeper-based sharpshooter detachments used hunting guns and light muskets, accurate but slow to fire. The Sonderbund's armament was older still: the farm levies had mostly their own flintlock muskets and shotguns, with parts made locally and maintenance in the hands of village smiths, and supply in the winter mountains was extremely hard. Artillery was the cruellest element of all: the federal artillery numbered about eighty-eight guns, including six- and twelve-pounders and mortars, and outranged and outfired the enemy on every axis, while the Sonderbund had barely a dozen serviceable guns in the whole country, most of them old cast-iron pieces with equally restricted production of powder and equally restricted transport. In cavalry the cantons had only light dragoons and mounted messengers, with no independent cavalry brigade; the engineers carried bridging and demolition stores, used to blow up bridges, monastery walls and village fortifications. Transport ran by wagon teams and inland steamers, the federal army drawing food and powder from the cantonal magazines, while the Sonderbund drew on monastery stores, and in the snow season that gap widened further.
tactics: 聯邦軍的戰法是「封閉缺口、三路並進」：計畫是從琉森州的西部、南部與中部同時推進，奪取對方的堡壘與城鎮，切斷其兵員與糧食的聯繫。真正的關鍵是十一月二十五日夜間一支分隊奇襲沃倫施維爾，成功奪取萊厄斯河上的木橋與橋頭堡，把分離同盟在琉森以西的退路截斷；這一舉動使對方陣地由縱深作戰變成各自固守，戰局在當夜已定。一八四七年十一月二十九日楚爾堡一戰是全場決戰：聯邦軍中央縱隊在平原上正面推進，分離同盟以縱隊與縱深射擊抵抗；聯邦右翼在聖米迦勒教堂與「三邦石碑」一線被分離同盟預備隊擊退，幾乎被分割，聯邦軍靠中央突破與預備隊及時壓上才取勝。分離同盟的戰術是依托修道院、村莊與岩谷的據點死守，把少量火炮封鎖道路，期望以冬季與援兵拖住對手，而不是主動出擊；問題在於其火炮不足，據點之間無法互相支援，聯邦軍每奪一堡，其守軍即被俘，戰局像多米諾骨牌般崩解。最後在十二月一日琉森城開門投降，弗萊堡與瓦萊州於一八四八年一月先後投降，戰事在不到一個月內結束。
tacticsEn: The federal method was to close the gaps and advance in three columns: the plan was to push simultaneously from the west, the south and the centre of the canton of Lucerne, to take the opposing works and towns and cut the enemy from his men and his food. The decisive stroke was the surprise attack by a federal detachment on the night of 25 November at Wohlenschwil, which carried the timber bridge over the Reuss and its bridgehead, cutting the Sonderbund's retreat westward; with that done the enemy position changed from a defence in depth into a set of isolated strongholds, and the issue was settled that night. The battle of Chur on 29 November 1847 was the decisive action of the campaign: the federal centre advanced in column across the plain against Sonderbund columns answering with deep fire, and the federal right was beaten back at the church of St. Michael and the Dreibündenstein by the Sonderbund reserves, almost thrown apart, only the breakthrough of the centre and the timely arrival of the federal reserves turning the battle. The Sonderbund tactic was to hold fast in monasteries, villages and rock valleys, closing the roads with its few guns in the hope that winter and outside aid would wear the attacker down, rather than to attack at all. The problem was that with so little artillery the strongpoints could not support one another, and every work the federal army took cost its garrison in captures, so the front came down like a row of dominoes. Lucerne opened its gates on 1 December, Fribourg and Valais capitulated in January 1848, and the war was over in under a month.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下：戰事自一八四七年十一月下旬聯邦軍動員越境起算，到十一月二十九日楚爾堡決戰、十二月一日琉森投降，前後約一週；弗萊堡於一八四八年一月十六日、瓦萊州於一八四八年一月二十八日先後投降，若把這些收尾算入，則為約兩個月。聯邦軍出動兵力約一萬二千至一萬五千人，砲約八十八門；分離同盟方面可徵召的兵力約一萬五千至兩萬人，但可用火炮僅十餘門，訓練與裝備明顯不足。損失方面，聯邦軍陣亡約一百四十人、重傷約五百七十人，分離同盟陣亡約三百至三百八十人、重傷約四百至六百人，各家說法略有出入。作戰地域集中在琉森州恩特萊布赫與楚爾一帶的山谷與公路，聯邦軍在北方以馳道與內河船運輸，冬季山區運補每日可行數公里，糧秣調度因此成為限制行動速度的主要因素。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. Counting from the federal mobilisation and crossing of the border in the second half of November 1847, through the decision at Chur on 29 November and the surrender of Lucerne on 1 December, the main campaign lasted about a week; Fribourg capitulated on 16 January 1848 and Valais on 28 January, so counting the clean-up the whole business took roughly two months. The federal army put about twelve to fifteen thousand men into the field with some eighty-eight guns; the Sonderbund could muster fifteen to twenty thousand men but had only a dozen serviceable guns, and was plainly short of training and equipment. In losses the federal side lost about one hundred and forty men killed and five hundred and seventy wounded, while the Sonderbund lost about three hundred to three hundred and eighty killed and four hundred to six hundred wounded, with accounts differing slightly. The fighting was concentrated in the valleys and roads around the Entlebuch and Chur in the canton of Lucerne; the federal army moved on the north by post road and inland steamer, and in the winter mountains the supply line advanced only a few kilometres a day, which made the pace of operations a question of food rather than of marching.
cause: 起因是一場已經被選舉否決過一次的制度衝突。一八三〇年代瑞士各州在政教與教育問題上的分歧加深：一八四一年至四三年，阿爾高州議會解散了州內的天主教修道院，天主教方面視之為侵犯教權，琉森、烏里、施維茨、瓦爾登、楚格、弗萊堡與瓦萊七州於一八四五年組成「分離同盟」，並向聯邦議會提出修改聯邦憲法的修正案；一八四四年八月二十二日舉行的全國公民投票否決了修正案，這次失敗使分離同盟相信只有握有自保之力才靠得住。一八四七年聯邦議會決定全面修憲，內容包括建立聯邦軍隊、設立聯邦法院、統一公民權與選舉制度，這等於要從根上拔掉各州的主權基礎；九月十二日分離同盟議會決議以武力抵抗修憲，隨後各州開始徵召、囤積糧彈並封鎖山道，十月二十九日聯邦議會正式宣佈分離同盟的聯邦條款無效、解散其議會並著令繳械，這道命令把原本還可談判的僵局推成了戰爭。真正引爆戰事的，是聯邦軍在十一月下旬越境推進、分離同盟各州地方武裝在聖加侖與施維茨一帶的零星衝突，以及聯邦當局對奧地利裔士兵與外交護照的干預，眾多摩擦在同一個多月內匯成全面開火。
causeEn: The cause was an institutional conflict that had already been rejected once at the polls. Through the 1830s the differences between the Swiss cantons over religion and education deepened. Between 1841 and 1843 the Aargau council dissolved the Catholic monasteries in its territory, which the Catholics took as an infringement of church rights, and the seven cantons of Lucerne, Uri, Schwyz, Unterwalden, Zug, Fribourg and Valais formed the Sonderbund in 1845, presenting an amendment to the federal constitution. The national referendum of 22 August 1844 rejected it, and that defeat taught the Sonderbund that only a power of its own could be relied upon. In 1847 the Diet decided on a thorough revision of the federal constitution, providing for a federal army, a federal court, a uniform citizenship and uniform electoral rules, which struck at the root of cantonal sovereignty; on 12 September the Sonderbund assembly resolved to resist the revision by force, the cantons began to levy, to hoard food and powder and to close the mountain tracks, and on 29 October the Diet formally annulled the Sonderbund's federal articles, dissolved its assembly and ordered its arms surrendered, a decree that turned a deadlock which might still have been negotiated into a war. What actually set the war alight was the federal advance across the border in the last days of November, the scattered clashes of local Sonderbund bands around St. Gallen and Schwyz, and the federal interference with Austrian soldiers and diplomatic passports; a number of separate frictions converged within a single month into general hostilities.
impact: 影響深遠而具體。其一，分離同盟的解體使瑞士的教派政治告一段落，一八四八年九月通過的聯邦憲法確立了聯邦議會、聯邦法院、聯邦軍與統一的公民權，成為現代瑞士聯邦國家的制度起點；一八七四年的憲法全面修訂把權力進一步收向聯邦，正是為防止再次出現地方聯盟式的抵抗。其二，天主教修道院系統在戰後遭到清算，耶穌會在瑞士被禁止，這一處置延續了瑞士宗教改革的傳統，也把教會問題固定在國家框架內。其三，戰爭的處理方式成為歐洲各國的案例：分離同盟的代表向奧地利、法國、普魯士與英國求援，得到的只有道義支持，這說明十九世紀的保守君主願意在文字上聲援教派叛亂，卻不願在邊境上開火；結果反過來也說明國家可以用聯邦武力壓過地方武裝而無需外國介入。其四，分離同盟是十九世紀歐洲少數真正成事的反革命叛亂，它的失敗對此後的保守派是一次打擊，對自由派則是一個示範：義大利北部與奧地利帝國的衝突、丹麥與普魯士之間的石勒蘇益格糾紛，都在不同程度上重演過「地方聯盟對中央軍隊」的劇本。其五，戰後大批分離同盟的教士與支持者流亡奧地利與法國，成為天主教保守主義在歐洲的一支跨界力量。
impactEn: The consequences were deep and specific. First, the dissolution of the Sonderbund ended confessional party politics in Switzerland; the federal constitution of September 1848 established the federal assembly, a federal court, a federal army and a uniform citizenship, and became the institutional starting point of the modern Swiss federal state. The total revision of 1874 moved power further towards the federation, precisely to forestall any repetition of a cantonal alliance resisting the centre. Second, the system of Catholic monasteries was liquidated after the war and the Jesuits were banned in Switzerland, a measure that carried on the tradition of the Swiss Reformation and fixed the church question inside the framework of the state. Third, the way the war was handled became a case study across Europe: the Sonderbund's deputies appealed to Austria, France, Prussia and Britain and received moral support only, which showed that nineteenth-century conservative sovereigns would back a confessional revolt in words but would not open a border for it. The result worked the other way as well, demonstrating that a state could crush an armed cantonal alliance without foreign intervention. Fourth, the Sonderbund was one of the few counter-revolutionary revolts in nineteenth-century Europe that actually succeeded, and its failure was a blow to conservatives and a demonstration to liberals: the conflicts in northern Italy and the Austrian empire, and the Schleswig-Holstein quarrel between Denmark and Prussia, all in some degree replayed the drama of a cantonal alliance against a federal army. Fifth, large numbers of Sonderbund clergy and supporters went into exile in Austria and France and became a transnational force of Catholic conservatism in Europe.
result: 結果是分離同盟在二十六天內被解體，聯邦軍未受重創便佔領了七個天主教州。十一月三十日聯邦軍進駐楚爾，一八四七年十二月一日琉森城開門投降，分離同盟的總部解散，其成員被解除武裝、逐出各州或在限期內離境，數十名修士與教士被驅逐，聯邦當局沒收其武裝與文件；弗萊堡在一八四八年一月十六日、瓦萊州在一月二十八日分別投降，殘存的零星抵抗隨之瓦解。聯邦議會隨即著手修憲，一八四八年九月十二日通過新憲法，瑞士從邦聯走向聯邦，成立聯邦軍、聯邦法院與兩院制議會，這些制度延續至今並在戰時的實踐中被檢驗：聯邦軍在戰後成為國家主權的執行者，維也納會議式的干預未能成功，維也納對聯邦扣押其駐瓦萊州軍團一事提出的外交交涉，最後只是以外交辯論了事。結果的殘酷之處在於雙方的打算都沒有錯：分離同盟估計聯邦不敢動武、也得不到外國出兵，聯邦估計只要火炮與人數佔優，數週即可定局，兩者都算對了一半，而戰爭的天平倒向了算對的那一半。
resultEn: The result was that the Sonderbund was broken up in twenty-six days, and the federal army occupied the seven Catholic cantons without serious loss. On 30 November the federal troops entered Chur, and on 1 December 1847 Lucerne opened its gates; the Sonderbund's headquarters was dissolved, its members were disarmed and expelled or given a term to leave, several dozen monks and priests were driven out, and the federal authorities seized their arms and papers. Fribourg capitulated on 16 January 1848 and Valais on 28 January, and the last scattered resistance fell away with them. The Diet then set about the revision, and the new constitution of 12 September 1848 turned Switzerland from a confederation into a federal state with a federal army, a federal court and a bicameral assembly, institutions that endure to this day and that were tested in practice during the war: the federal army became the instrument of national sovereignty, interference of the Vienna-concert kind failed, and the diplomatic protest Vienna made over the internment of its regiment in Valais ended in argument alone. What makes the outcome brutal is that neither side's estimate was wrong. The Sonderbund reckoned that the federation would not dare to use force and would get no foreign troops; the federation reckoned that with the guns and the numbers on its side the business would be settled in a few weeks. Each was half right, and the war tipped towards the half that was right.
